description:
DEMOLITION OF THE EXISTING REAR EXTENSION AND
ERECTION OF A SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION, TOGETHER WITH THE FORMATION OF A
RAISED DECKING AREA. ALSO THE ERECTION OF A REAR DORMER EXTENSION AND
ASSOCIATED ALTERATIONS TO THE ROOF.
decision_conditions:
Removal of PD (Windows/Doors) - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)(England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no window, door or other opening other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed in the east facing elevation of the extension hereby approved without planning permission first being obtained from the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of nearby properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

﻿Fire Strategy - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Strategy Statement (Reasonable Exemption Statement) submitted with the application and must fully comply with The Building Regulation 2010 (as amended) unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.

Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

Boundary Treatment - Prior to the first use of the extension and raised terrace hereby approved, the boundary screening shown on drawing 122_PL_GA_03 shall be erected in accordance with the approved plans. The fencing shall be retained thereafter unless first agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.


Reason: To ensure a satisfactory and safe development in accordance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024

No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.
